# Build with Bastion.

Developer guides for connecting your application to fraud scoring, bot protection, signed webhooks, and workspace SSO.

Source: [site documentation](https://web-production-c0739.up.railway.app/docs) · platform revision `4b7879729687067d55fe230a0503385b205c0018`.

<a id="integration-model"></a>

## One collection layer. Your server in control.

Collect device and behavior telemetry in your frontend. Send the complete verification request to your backend. Your backend supplies trusted account and order details, calls Bastion with the site secret, and enforces the returned action before completing a sensitive operation.

| Step | Runs in | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 01 · Collect | Customer browser | Public site key; fingerprint, behavior, environment, and token. |
| 02 · Verify | Your application server | Authenticate the customer, load authoritative context, and score with the secret key. |
| 03 · Enforce | Your application server | Allow, hold for review, challenge, or block. |
| 04 · Reconcile | Your webhook receiver | Verify signatures and durably process decision.created deliveries. |

- [Quickstart](quickstart.md) — Connect a browser and an authenticated backend.
- [API reference](api-reference.md) — Requests, decisions, authentication, and batches.

<a id="base-urls"></a>

## Endpoints and credentials

**bash**

```bash
# Data plane: browser collection and server verification
BASTION_ENDPOINT=https://api-production-761a5.up.railway.app/api/antibot

# Server environment only. Obtain keys in Workspace → Integration.
BASTION_SITE_KEY=YOUR_PUBLIC_SITE_KEY
BASTION_SECRET_KEY=YOUR_SERVER_SECRET

# Webhook receiver only. Obtain in Workspace → Webhooks.
BASTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET=YOUR_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET
```

> **Three separate credentials**
>
> The public site key identifies a site. The server secret authenticates scoring calls. The webhook signing secret authenticates deliveries. Dashboard automation uses a Bearer access token instead. Never expose either secret through a frontend environment variable.
